title: Solving a system by substitution
subject: Math
learningGoal: Solve a two-variable system using substitution.
spokenLines: Two equations, two unknowns. Let's solve.
Equation one: y equals two x plus one.
Equation two: three x plus y equals eleven.
y is already isolated in the first one — perfect for substitution.
Substitute two x plus one into equation two.
That gives three x plus two x plus one equals eleven.
Combine: five x plus one equals eleven.
Solve: five x equals ten, so x equals two.
Back-substitute: y equals two times two plus one, which is five.
Answer: x is two, y is five. That's where the two lines meet.
